CustomField.label: Integration Sync JIRA
CustomField.description: Product2.Sync_JIRA__c read through to the product, so record-triggered Flows can select the Order Products that create a System Setup ticket. Exists because the Order Product's own Sync_JIRA__c (CPQ twin field) is not populated on most orders (false on 328 of 332 flagged Order Products of the last 90 days, checked 3 Oct 2026). Used by the Salesforce -> Jira integration (Scenario 1). Agreed with Swati Sharma, 5 Oct 2026. MuleSoft reads Product2.Sync_JIRA__c through SOQL, never this field.
